reused_dependency.rule: Reuse the registered hard-valid source hashes and base 100ms event formula; do not rerun its discovery dates.

base_event.rearm: BTC direction-signed displacement <=25% of detected shock for ten consecutive 100ms states.

if_stage_1_passes.signal: Same attention regime and 12bp-or-larger underreaction residual formula; each economic impulse may create one candidate per follower/horizon before the global slot.
if_stage_1_passes.candidate_priority: At each decision time choose the largest completed direction-aligned residual gap; ties BTC shock z then follower symbol then shorter horizon.
entry: First follower public trade at or after decision time plus 100ms.
Same frozen signal replay with first follower public trade at or after decision time plus 300ms as latency stress.
if_stage_1_passes.position: Trade in BTC shock direction, at most one SOLUSDT or XRPUSDT position globally.
exit: Gap closure: direction-aligned residual gap <=25% of entry gap for ten consecutive 100ms states.
Leader invalidation: BTC direction-signed displacement from shock start <=0 for ten consecutive 100ms states.
Adverse follower invalidation: follower moves against entry by at least 50% of entry gap.
if_stage_1_passes.unvalued_rule: Missing entry, missing state exit, stale mark or any funding boundary crossing invalidates the path and fails the gate; funding is not approximated.

if_stage_1_fails.attention_regime: Same fixed prior trade-count and relative-volatility regime.
if_stage_1_fails.base_btc_shock: Same completed 100ms BTC price-flow shock and prior-only beta/scale/activity formula.

overreaction.trade_direction: Opposite the BTC shock direction only in a later separately frozen PnL study.

information_contract.decision: Only after the entire leader and contemporaneous follower horizon is complete.
